v84: FAILS - hermesc rejects the `class` keyword entirely, same root cause as
     32-class-basic/versions.txt (no IRGen lowering for
     ClassDeclaration/ClassExpression at all in this build).
v94: FAILS - identical error, same root cause.
v96: FAILS - identical error, same root cause.
v98: OK - classes, `extends`, class fields and private fields all supported.
v99: OK - same.

Only v98.hbc/v99.hbc exist in this directory; tests/fixtures/build.sh skips
v84/v94/v96 for this fixture, matching this file.

The `sum` member's computed key (the escape shape, see source.js) makes the
v99 build emit `CallBuiltin HermesBuiltin.setFunctionName`, which the
tools/hermes-vm/v99 runtime predates (same as 64-computed-method-names);
expected.txt is the v98 VM's output, identical to the source's semantics.
